'''Scribing''' was a [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]] [[Fallanassi powers|power]]. The power allowed a Fallanassi to make marks or inscriptions that were undetectable by normal or even artificial senses. Other Fallanassi could uncover the marks by using the [[Sense Scribing]] power. Fallanassi used the power to leave trails for other Fallanassi to follow, and the marks remained even if the surface was defaced or partially destroyed.<ref name="CTD" />
